visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair wearing pink overalls and a white top sits with a young girl on a kitchen counter. They are lifting a transparent cylindrical lid off a white cake box to reveal a decorated cake. (2) A close-up reveals a white frosted cake decorated with green frosting grass, pink flowers, and a white fondant rabbit topper. Yellow confetti overlays float across the screen, adding a festive and celebratory visual atmosphere. (3) The woman stands outdoors against a textured grey metal garage door and concrete wall. She speaks directly to the camera, gesturing widely with her hands, wearing the same pink overalls and a white bag strap over her shoulder. (4) Inside a bright, minimalist kitchen studio, the woman and an instructor are standing behind a counter. The instructor wears a dark blue apron over a white t-shirt, and several bowls of ingredients and baking tools are visible. (5) A series of rapid shots show baking steps: sifting white flour through a metal sieve, whisking yellow egg yolks in a large stainless steel bowl, and using a hand-held electric mixer to beat white egg whites. (6) The instructor tilts a metal bowl upside down to demonstrate the stiffness of the whipped egg white foam, which remains perfectly in place. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the food. (7) Hands are shown molding white and pink fondant into the shape of a rabbit's head, ears, and body. Tools like a small spatula and a pointed pick are used for fine details on a blue silicone mat. (8) The final cake is shown on a rotating glass stand. The woman poses next to it, making a peace sign and smiling. A large poster of the instructor holding a cake is visible in the background.

The BGM remains constant in the background while the woman's voice exhibits high valence and friendly tone. (3) The sound of a metallic oven door clicking shut is clearly heard. The acoustic texture shifts slightly to a more resonant room tone as the instruction begins. The teacher's voice is professional and clear with a moderate pitch. This is layered over a steady, rhythmic whisking sound against a metal bowl, creating a dense percussive texture. (5) Multiple fast transition whooshes are synchronized with visual cuts. The BGM swells slightly in volume during the non-vocal montage section, featuring a clear, melodic piano line and steady rhythmic guitar strumming. (6) High-pitched 'Ding' sound effects occur frequently, highlighting promotional points. The narration becomes faster and more authoritative, using a persuasive pitch contour as the volume of the speech increases relative to the background music.
